output.reason: Issue #14152, which PR #21492 closes, makes `applyNestedSelectors: true` "the default and only option for matrix/merge generators" and drops the field [ev-293cba9e28f6][ev-15936265edd6][ev-f5ff9ce56464]. So an ApplicationSet with nested selectors that previously weren't applied now has them applied. It keeps working but may generate a different set of Applications. No evidence says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so behavior-change (review) is the supported kind. Confidence is low because an explicit `applyNestedSelectors: false` would stop being honoured, which could arguably count as setting-ignored for that slice.
